result:
The round 123 review (Ableton expert review, part 1, areas P1–P8) is done and passes. I ran every area in a real browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720 and found no bug at Medium or above. That means round 124 should be review part 2 (areas Q1–Q7), not a fix-up round. Nothing in `store/` changed: HEAD is `608187f`, the tree is clean and the sha256 list matched at both start and end.

**How I checked:** Playwright Chromium, a fresh context per session, no credentials, on `/studio-lab` only. Audio was measured on the real-time output and in exported WAV data, not judged by ear. The reference was the Live 12 manual: the saved captures, plus two chapters I fetched and saved as text (Browser, and Recording New Clips for the metronome). I opened the cited screenshots and wrote a description of each into `c-round-123.md`.

**Bugs (both Low, so they go to `deferred_low_polish`):**
- **ABL-B-1:** while a library item is being previewed, its "▶ ისმის" badge spills out of the item's card: "▶" sits past the edge and "ისმის" is cut off by the list edge. It happens at both viewports.
- **ABL-B-2:** pressing Z a second time on the same range adds an empty zoom-history step, so the first X does nothing visible while the status line says the previous view was restored. It's related to the already-deferred C-R108-01.

**Main checks that matched Live 12:**
- **BPM never moves audio:** in exported WAVs at 120, 90 and 143 BPM and with no BPM set, the clip starts at exactly sample 96000 (2.000 s).
- **Metronome:** it clicks every 0.5 s at 120 BPM, accents the first beat of each bar (about 6 dB louder), and adds nothing to the export.
- **Alt and Snap:** Alt bypasses Snap when it's on and temporarily enables it when it's off, as the manual says.
- Editing and navigation matched Live's manual text in both viewports (detail in the appendix tables of `user-review/ableton-review.md`).

**10 recommendations (ABL-R), all waiting for Saba's decision; nothing gets implemented before that.** The two Medium ones:
- **ABL-R-7:** add Live's missing time commands: Paste Time, Duplicate Time, Insert Silence. Two related keys also do nothing and show no message today: Ctrl+Shift+C and Ctrl+I.
- **ABL-R-10:** fix `M` during playback. It opens the marker name field, so the next Space types into the name and playback keeps running. If an old range is still selected, `M` places the marker at the range start, not the playhead. Opening the field right away was your own request (plan R3), so this proposes changing it only during playback.

The other eight are Low: missing Live keys (library, detail panel, metronome, lane height, U to fold a lane, focusing search), an adaptive grid, and two questions (empty-project Play, and adding a lane when you drop below the last one).

**What couldn't run, or comes with a caveat:**
- The `ableton-arrangement-expert` agent couldn't be called because there's no subagent tool on this runner. I read its role file instead, and the review rests only on my browser results and the manual text.
- The fake-Bearer 403 check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.
- Ctrl+digit, a lone Alt, Shift+F10 and real touch can't be sent through CDP.
- Two early screenshots showed a stray text highlight on the SFX header. Four targeted tries didn't reproduce it, so I left it as an observation for B, not a bug.
- Several first-pass runs were invalid because of my own scripts (for example, clicks landing off-screen). Each was replaced, and they're listed under `invalidRuns`.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- `user-review/ableton-review.md`
- `c-round-123.json`
- `c-round-123.md`
- `c-round-123/` (`tools`, `out`, `shots`, `manual`, `progress.json`)
